target.title: security(audit): warn on plugin load paths and SecretRef env fallback
target.body:
<details>
<summary>Additional instructions</summary>

**MUST:** Keep **Allow edits from maintainers** enabled for this PR so maintainers
can help update the branch when needed.

</details>

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes two operator visibility gaps in OpenClaw security posture checks:

1. **`plugins.load.paths` trust-boundary risk** — Operators can point `plugins.load.paths` at arbitrary local directories, but `openclaw security audit` did not evaluate those configured paths for filesystem risk (world-writable paths, missing entries, bundled aliases, synced folders) before runtime plugin load.
2. **SecretRef env fallback visibility** — Runtime secret resolution can fall back to environment variables in some configurations; operators lacked a dedicated audit finding when that fallback was active.

**Concrete example:** An operator adds a world-writable `/tmp/demo-plugin` to `plugins.load.paths` and configures gateway auth via SecretRef that silently resolves from `OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN`. Before this PR, `openclaw security audit` did not surface either risk explicitly.

## Why This Change Was Made

Adds `collectPluginLoadPathFindings` and wires SecretRef env-fallback diagnostics into `openclaw security audit` / doctor health contributions so misconfiguration surfaces as explicit findings instead of silent trust expansion.

Shared diagnostics live in `src/secrets/secretref-env-fallback-diagnostics.ts` so audit and doctor use one detector. `isActiveGatewayTokenSurface` forwards caller-provided `env` into `resolveGatewayAuth` so injected audit/doctor env is not ignored.

## User Impact

**Before:** Risky plugin load paths and active SecretRef env fallbacks could go unnoticed.

**After:** `openclaw security audit` emits `plugins.load_paths.*` and `secrets.ref_env_fallback_used` findings operators can act on. Doctor lint exposes the same SecretRef fallback via `core/doctor/secretref-env-fallback`. No runtime behavior change unless operators remediate.

## Evidence

- `src/security/audit-plugin-load-paths.ts` — `collectPluginLoadPathFindings`
- `src/security/audit-secretref-env-fallback.ts` — maps shared diagnostics to audit findings
- `src/secrets/secretref-env-fallback-diagnostics.ts` — shared diagnostic collector
- `src/flows/doctor-core-checks.ts` — `core/doctor/secretref-env-fallback`
- `src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.ts` — wired into `doctor:gateway-auth`; `doctor:default-account-routing` preserved
- `docs/gateway/security/audit-checks.md` — catalog rows for the new check IDs

## Real behavior proof

- **Behavior or issue addressed:** `openclaw security audit` and `openclaw doctor --lint` now emit the new warnings for a real risky config (world-writable `plugins.load.paths` + unresolved gateway SecretRef falling back to `OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN`).
- **Canonical reachability path:**

```text
node scripts/run-node.mjs security audit
  → runSecurityAudit
  → collectPluginLoadPathFindings / collectSecretRefEnvFallbackFindings
  → plugins.load_paths.world_writable + secrets.ref_env_fallback_used

node scripts/run-node.mjs doctor --lint --all --only core/doctor/secretref-env-fallback --json
  → CORE_HEALTH_CHECKS[core/doctor/secretref-env-fallback]
  → collectSecretRefEnvFallbackDiagnostics
```

- **Boundary crossed:** local-runtime CLI against an isolated `OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR` / `OPENCLAW_CONFIG_PATH` (not personal HOME). No mocks of the audit/doctor collectors for the CLI proof.
- **Shared helper / provider constraint check:** N/A (local security audit + doctor lint).
- **Real environment tested:** macOS Darwin 24.3.0 arm64, Node v22.22.0, commit `daa40479c14` rebased onto current `upstream/main`.
- **Exact steps or command run after this patch:**

```text
# Isolated risky config (paths redacted)
OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR=/tmp/oc-audit-proof-XXXXXX/state \
OPENCLAW_CONFIG_PATH=/tmp/oc-audit-proof-XXXXXX/state/openclaw.json \
OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN=proof-env-fallback-token \
node scripts/run-node.mjs security audit

OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR=... OPENCLAW_CONFIG_PATH=... OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN=... \
node scripts/run-node.mjs doctor --lint --all --only core/doctor/secretref-env-fallback --json

node scripts/run-vitest.mjs \
  src/security/audit-plugin-load-paths.test.ts \
  src/security/audit-secretref-env-fallback.test.ts \
  src/secrets/secretref-env-fallback-diagnostics.test.ts \
  --reporter=verbose
```

Config shape used for CLI proof:

```json
{
  "gateway": {
    "mode": "local",
    "auth": {
      "mode": "token",
      "token": { "source": "env", "provider": "default", "id": "MISSING_GATEWAY_TOKEN" }
    }
  },
  "secrets": { "providers": { "default": { "source": "env" } } },
  "plugins": { "load": { "paths": ["/tmp/oc-audit-proof-XXXXXX/demo-plugin"] } }
}
```

(`demo-plugin` directory chmod `777`, with minimal `openclaw.plugin.json` + `index.ts`.)

- **Evidence after fix:**

```text
$ node scripts/run-node.mjs security audit

OpenClaw security audit
Summary: 2 critical · 4 warn · 2 info

CRITICAL
plugins.load_paths.world_writable Plugin load path is world-writable
  - /private/tmp/oc-audit-proof-XXXXXX/demo-plugin: blocked plugin candidate: world-writable path (... mode=777)
  Fix: Tighten directory permissions (for example chmod 755) or move plugin sources out of world-writable locations.

WARN
secrets.ref_env_fallback_used Configured SecretRef fell back to environment credentials
  Runtime secret resolution used provider env fallback after a configured SecretRef failed:
  - gateway.auth.token: gateway.auth.token SecretRef could not be resolved; runtime is using OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN env fallback.
  Fix: Fix the configured SecretRef source or remove stale env fallback credentials so runtime uses the intended secret boundary.

INFO
plugins.load_paths.trust_boundary Explicit plugin load paths configured
  - Configured explicit plugin load paths (1): /tmp/oc-audit-proof-XXXXXX/demo-plugin.

$ node scripts/run-node.mjs doctor --lint --all --only core/doctor/secretref-env-fallback --json
{"ok":false,"checksRun":1,"checksSkipped":52,"findings":[{"checkId":"core/doctor/secretref-env-fallback","severity":"warning","message":"gateway.auth.token SecretRef could not be resolved; runtime is using OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN env fallback.","path":"gateway.auth.token","fixHint":"Resolve the configured SecretRef source or remove stale env fallback credentials so runtime uses the intended secret boundary."}]}

$ node scripts/run-node.mjs doctor --lint --all --only core/doctor/default-account-routing --json
{"ok":true,"checksRun":1,"checksSkipped":52,"findings":[]}

$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/security/audit-plugin-load-paths.test.ts \
    src/security/audit-secretref-env-fallback.test.ts \
    src/secrets/secretref-env-fallback-diagnostics.test.ts --reporter=verbose
 ✓ audit-plugin-load-paths / audit-secretref-env-fallback — 4 passed
 ✓ secretref-env-fallback-diagnostics — 4 passed
[test] passed 2 Vitest shards in 5.17s
```

- **Observed result after fix:** Production CLI emits `plugins.load_paths.world_writable` (critical) and `secrets.ref_env_fallback_used` (warn). Doctor lint emits `core/doctor/secretref-env-fallback`. Restored `core/doctor/default-account-routing` still registers and runs.
- **What was not tested:** Live Gateway deep probe (`--deep`) against a running managed gateway; Crabbox/Testbox remote lane not required for this local CLI diagnostic path.
- **Fix classification:** Root cause / visibility fix (new diagnostics; no runtime auth or plugin-load behavior change).

- [x] AI-assisted (Cursor / Grok)
- [x] I understand what the code does
- [x] Change is focused and does not mix unrelated concerns
